verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an auth product, since competing auth platforms ship dashboards where one could live, so the axis applies. Better Auth's evidence covers only AI-adjacent features: a remote MCP server for external MCP clients (docs search and setup help), an MCP OAuth plugin, and 'auth for AI agents' delegation. None of these is an assistant inside the product that a user can hand tasks to.
